title: Standard opens form a basis on Proj
statement: Let $S$ be a graded commutative ring [def-pc-proj] and let $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj]. The standard opens $D_+(f)$ for positive-degree homogeneous $f$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero] form a basis for the topology of $X$; each $D_+(f)$ is affine.
